description: This file defines the 'Report' interface for the OrangeHRM project, specifying methods to retrieve header definitions, filter definitions, and report data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report, describing how table headers are normalized.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter definition used for the report, describing how filters are normalized.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on provided filter parameters.
